title: azorella lyallii
intro: Azorella lyallii, commonly known as 'Inch Plant' or 'Maori Tea Tree', is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. It has been used for centuries in traditional Maori medicine, valued for its health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion and reduce inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to protect against oxidative stress and promote wound healing. Azorella lyallii contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
